scene: The snatched card activates transit gates for three distant sky districts.
picture: A flat side view of the grand transit sky-dock. On the left hangs an open round cable pod. The player in her red bomber jacket and roller skates stands left-centre holding the glowing passcard. In the centre sits an idling pink bullet train. On the right, a docked wooden solar-sail junk gently bobs.
shown: a dangling round cloud cable pod waiting open on the left
a sleek pink bullet train idling with open doors at centre
a docked solar-sail junk ship with glowing sails on the right
